provenance.enumeration_limitations: Finds aligned 12-byte data-section descriptors with dotted decoded names and handlers in updated main text, plus null-terminated 16-byte hierarchy candidates. Dormant aliases and callback-table lookalikes may be present. Static registration calls supply some hierarchy namespaces; live enumeration is needed. This is NOT a 100% runtime inventory.
provenance.format_limitations: Parser format literals are recovered evidence, not complete command signatures; descriptor context is not argument count.

list.note: Silently returns without listing when gate is nonzero. Zero arguments otherwise lists all; optional string filters narrow the list.

iterator_reset.note: Resets only the enumeration index at 0x20b85264.

iterator_next.note: No list gate. Increments the index and outputs one full command name, or iter_done after the registry ends.
